protocol.selection: Keep 30 pilot traces; exact GTR tagged historical records, >=14 pairs, exclude 速攻/malformed/non-pair. Add source-order records round-robin by least represented player until 500 unique match keys. Not all-video-verified.
protocol.split: Pilot split retained; subsequently every fifth added player trace holdout. Frozen before expanded scoring; historical collection already viewed only as raw records.
protocol.colorNormalization: first appearance maps to red, green, blue, yellow; reject >4 colors in retained prefix
protocol.deduplication: Date plus color-normalized first 8 pairs. One player's placement trace per key; conservative proxy because historical source has no original game IDs.
protocol.comparison: First 12 turns before first human clear; live CURRENT/NEXT/NEXT2 only, human board retained. Same-board agreement is diagnostic, not proof of optimality.

records.verification: video frame checked at 3:10 (first 4 placements); full trace not video-audited
